question: The marked price of a wardrobe is ₹668, which is 22% above the cost price. If the profit percentage is 7%, find the discount percentage (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) of the wardrobe = ₹668

Cost Price (CP) = MP / (1 + 22/100) = ₹668 / 1.22

Profit Percentage = 7%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit Percentage/100)

Discount Percentage = [(MP - SP) / MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

CP = ₹668 / 1.22

⇒ CP = ₹547.54

⇒ SP = CP × (1 + 7/100)

⇒ SP = ₹547.54 × 1.07

⇒ SP = ₹585.86

⇒ Discount Percentage = [(MP - SP) / MP] × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = [(₹668 - ₹585.86) / ₹668] × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = (₹82.14 / ₹668) × 100

⇒ Discount Percentage = 12.3%

**The discount percentage is 12.3%.**
